title: WaterColor "Seacolor" 838 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor, steps from Seaside- Large private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1st for $40 per day** - Gourmet kitchen: Wolf & Sub Zero appliances- 4K 65" TV with Sonos home theater system, Apple TV, Netflix, cable, & Blu-Ray- Outdoor fire pit, dining table, grill, & water fountain- 1 parking in back of house - 4 adult bikes - Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter cover covers, are laundered at every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: As the name implies "Seacolor" combines close proximity to bustling Seaside with the opulence of Watercolor. Located at the bike and walking access directly behind Seaside Town Center and just steps from all the fun. A tree-lined backyard with a large sparkling private pool is the crown jewel of this amazing home. Cool off with a refreshing swim or relax at the nearby gas fire pit. An outdoor dining table with seating for six offers a perfect place to enjoy meals alfresco. Relax in one of two screened-in porches to enjoy the tranquil sounds of the water fountain and views of the pool. No worries if you're home after dark as everything is lit for night-time entertaining with friends with the glistening pool as backdrop.A chic coastal style highlights an open-concept floor plan. White shiplap walls and 12-foot ceilings provide a bright refreshing ambiance. The luxury kitchen includes a gas range, top-of-the-line Wolf and Subzero appliances, quartz countertops, and new designer cabinets. The breakfast bar and nearby dining table flow to the family room with plenty of comfy seating throughout. After a day at the beach, gather for game-night, cook a family meal or enjoy a movie on the state-of-art home theater. Enjoy the plush downstairs primary suite with king-sized bed and private en suite bathroom with large dual vanity and sinks, gorgeous glass waterfall shower and separate soaking tub. Three guest rooms upstairs, each with en suite bathrooms. Two of the guest rooms have king-sized beds, a rare luxury. The third guest room has two twin-sized beds and two twin-sized trundle beds that are perfect for a kids slumber party.Book Seacolor today! Where sugar white sand, coastal emerald waters and the best of both Seaside and Watercolor await!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/ Jacuzzi Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds with Twin Trundles, Private Bathroom With Shower Tub Combo*Weddings and pets are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
